text: The LinnSequencer 32 Track MIDI Sequence Recorder
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; src=Title; dua baris digabung; transkripsi dari gambar scan; GT disalin dari UA12_p001 (konten sama)

text: The LinnSequencer is a state-of-the-art composition and performance tool for the professional musician. It is extremely powerful, yet amazingly simple to learn and use. It’s many remarkable features include:
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Operation is similar to multi-track tape recorder with PLAY, STOP, RECORD, FAST FORWARD, REWIND, and LOCATE controls.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Each of the 100 sequences contains 32 simultaneous, polyphonic tracks. Each track may be assigned to one of 16 MIDI channels. Simultaneously plays up to 16 polyphonic synthesizers!
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Ultra-fast 3½″ disk drive stores complex songs in seconds and holds over 110,000 notes per disk!
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan; 3½″ = tiga setengah inci, ditulis dengan karakter ½ dan ″

text: One or all tracks may be TRANSPOSED at the touch of a key.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Exclusive real-time ERASE function makes editing FAST.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Exclusive REPEAT function automatically repeats any held notes at a pre-selected rhythmic value.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: TIMING CORRECTION works during playback and operates without ‘chopping’ notes.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Optional SMPTE time code synchronization.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Optional remote control.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Recording a Sequence
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; src=Heading; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: To record a sequence, simply press RECORD and PLAY, then play your MIDI keyboard in time to the Sequencer’s click track. When the sequence loops back around to bar 1, you’ll hear what you played—only all timing errors will be corrected! (Timing correction may be adjusted or defeated). Any additional notes played will be added into the track —existing notes are not erased while recording!
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; transkripsi dari gambar scan; em dash di awal baris '—existing' dipertahankan dengan spasi sebelumnya

text: FAST FORWARD, REWIND, and LOCATE controls may be used at any time to quickly access any location in your sequence for spot-recording. To overdub a new part, select a different track and start recording—while you record, the first track will play in perfect sync (unless you MUTE it, or SOLO another track). In this way, up to 32 tracks may be overdubbed! All MIDI effects are recorded including pitch bend, modulation, velocity, aftertouch, sustain pedal, and program changes!
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Editing
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; src=Heading; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: To erase a wrong note, simply hold ERASE and press the note to be erased just before it plays in the sequence— when played back, it will be gone. Notes may also be added, erased, or changed using the SINGLE STEP func- tion. To overdub notes at specific points within a sequence, simply use LOCATE, FAST FORWARD, or REWIND to find the desired bar number, then start recording.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; transkripsi dari gambar scan; lintas_kolom; hyphen; em dash di akhir baris 'sequence—' diikuti spasi

text: The INSERT/COPY function allows you to move bars from one location to another—in the same sequence or a different one. For example, you might insert a copy of the first verse between the second chorus and the bridge. DELETE BARS operates the same way to remove unwanted sections.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Creating a Song
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; src=Heading; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: One way to create a song is to record each track all the way through (up to 999 bars). Another way is to record each basic section (verse, chorus, etc.) in individual sequences, then use the CREATE SONG function to “chain” them together. CREATE SONG will then automatically copy all the parts into a new sequence. If desired, you can even set the last few bars to repeat infinitely, for a fadeout.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Composition Without Compromise
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; src=Heading; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: The technology you use should never be so complex that it interferes with the creative process. That’s precisely why the LinnSequencer is designed to let you compose, record and edit while devoting your undivided attention to your music. See your Linn dealer today for a demonstration!
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Additional Features
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; src=Heading; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Simple, easy to learn operation—the 32 character LCD display clearly guides you through all operations. If needed, the HELP button displays additional explanations.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Non-destructive recording—existing notes are not erased while recording.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Two FOOTSWITCH INPUTS may be assigned to remotely control many of the commonly used functions, including ERASE, REPEAT, PLAY/STOP, or LOCATE.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Two TRIGGER OUTPUTS may be programmed to output pulses at any selected note value.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Will sync to standard LinnDrum or Linn 9000 sync tone.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Utilizes ultra high-speed, 8 MHz 80186 16 bit computer internally for FAST operation.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: TEMPO may be specified in BEATS-PER-MINUTE or FRAMES-PER-BEAT at 24, 25, or 30 frames per second, (even drop frame!)
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: TEMPO may be entered numerically, adjustable in tenths of a Beat-Per-Minute increments, or by tapping quarter notes on the TAP TEMPO button.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: TEMPO CHANGES may be programmed into a sequence, with smooth transitions if desired.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan

text: Any TIME SIGNATURE may be used, and may be changed within a song.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir tanpa nomor; transkripsi dari gambar scan
